standard-dialogue.npc: Hey there. Have you seen Frank?
Yes, Frank. He's my pet bloodveld. He runs off a lot so I was wondering if you'd seen him.

standard-dialogue.player: Frank doesn't seem like a very fitting name for a bloodveld.

standard-dialogue.npc: Oh, he was named after my last pet. That one wasn't a bloodveld though, that one was a human.
Yes! A pet human called Frank.
Frank was great. He died though. Mother said it was my fault, that I didn't feed him properly. I'm not allowed pet humans now.
It's okay though. Now I have Frank the bloodveld. He's great. I don't need to feed him. He feeds himself.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-not-d.npc: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
